propositions: ReconcilerConfig requires a new backend field defaulting to 'jira' with config-load validation via _as_choice coercer
A new _backend_registry module must provide select_backend(config) that reads config.reconciler.backend and returns a Backend instance via a decorator-based in-tree registry
JiraBackend must be registered under the 'jira' key using @register decorator, triggered by importing adapters package
select_backend() must lazily import adapters package to populate the registry deterministically before lookup, avoiding circular imports
Registry must support idempotent registration (same key+factory is no-op; conflicting factory raises) and provide _reset_registry_for_test() context manager for testing
No existing consumer of _load_acli, AcliClient construction sites, or differ/apply modules must be rewired in this story; rewiring is deferred to S4
